abstract_text: High-risk power-operation LLM agents need supervision that preserves authorized action fields while removing fields without valid authority. The current artifact implements fieldwise repair as an auditable final-action mode. Paper-ready evidence covers curated and expanded power-operation cases, metamorphic authority-confusion tests, skill-driven multi-source authority, baselines, and safety-preserving normal-behavior profiles. Trace evidence covers trace/span/OTLP replay, trace-import boundaries, planner-skill-tool-memory source chains, and bridge fixtures. We keep the boundary explicit: no production telemetry, no real operator workload reduction claim, and no official neighboring-system superiority claim.
